headline: Swiggy renews health and accident insurance for 25 lakh delivery partners with IndusInd General Insurance
hook: Safety net renewed for delivery partners
summary: Swiggy has renewed its group insurance policy covering 25 lakh delivery partners in partnership with IndusInd General Insurance. The renewed coverage provides accidental death protection of ₹10 lakh and in-patient hospitalisation expenses of up to ₹2 lakh. Additionally, delivery partners receive family health coverage of up to ₹1 lakh for medical emergencies. While this operational expense impacts Swiggy's logistics cost structure, retail investors should note how platforms manage gig-worker retention and welfare mandates.
why_it_matters: Gig worker welfare costs impact delivery platform margins
winners_losers: Delivery partners gain / platforms incur fixed costs

headline: IndusInd Bank shares rise over 2% following Q2 results as brokerages issue varied target prices
hook: Mixed broker views after Q2 numbers
summary: IndusInd Bank reported a quarterly net profit of ₹1,242 crore alongside stronger advances and lower bad loans, lifting its shares by over 2 percent. However, ongoing margin pressure from FCNR(B) deposits has tempered the bank's near-term outlook. Major brokerages remain divided on the stock, setting price targets between ₹950 and ₹1,200. Retail investors holding banking sector exposure should assess how deposit costs impact private lender margins.
whats_next: Brokerage target revisions and next quarter earnings
why_it_matters: Deposit costs pressure private bank margins.
winners_losers: IndusInd Bank shareholders mixed / margin-sensitive banks cautious

headline: IDBI Capital maintains bullish stance on IndusInd Bank following Q2 results
hook: Strong turnaround after last year's loss
summary: IndusInd Bank reported a net profit of Rs 1,176 crore for Q2 FY26, recovering from a net loss of Rs 444 crore in the same period last year. Retail investors holding the stock can assess the bank's profitability recovery as a positive indicator of operational turnaround.
why_it_matters: IndusInd Bank shareholders see renewed earnings stability

headline: IndusInd Bank outlines multi-year return on assets targets
hook: Long-term profitability targets set by IndusInd
summary: IndusInd Bank has announced a target to reach a 1% return on assets (RoA) by the fourth quarter of FY27. The bank maintains a medium-term aspiration of achieving an RoA between 1.75% and 1.8%. This guidance provides a roadmap for the bank's profitability trajectory over the next few years. Retail investors can use these targets to assess the bank's operational efficiency and long-term growth potential.
why_it_matters: Long-term profitability goals help gauge future stock valuation potential.

headline: IndusInd Bank swings to Q2 profit while brokerages revise targets
hook: Profit returns but brokerages trim targets
summary: IndusInd Bank reported a Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 1,176 crore, reversing a net loss of Rs 445 crore in the same period last year. Improved asset quality, lower provisions, and stronger fee income drove the recovery. Following the results, Jefferies kept a 'Buy' rating but lowered its target price to Rs 1,130, while Motilal Oswal retained a 'Neutral' rating with a Rs 1,050 target. Indian retail investors tracking banking stocks should monitor how asset quality trends impact valuation multiples.
whats_next: Next quarterly earnings release in January
why_it_matters: Valuation outlook cautious despite return to profitability
winners_losers: IndusInd Bank holders wait for valuation clarity
